date.instructions: Date printed on the receipt, exactly as printed.

first_item.instructions: Name of the first line item, without its quantity.

second_item.instructions: Name of the second line item, without its quantity.

third_item.instructions: Name of the third line item, without its quantity.

item_lines.instructions: How many line items are listed?

guests.instructions: Number of customers on the check.

subtotal.instructions: Subtotal in US dollars as a plain number, e.g. 12.50.

tax.instructions: Sales tax in US dollars as a plain number, e.g. 12.50.

total.instructions: Total due in US dollars as a plain number, e.g. 12.50.

tax_rate_percent.instructions: Sales tax as a percentage of the subtotal, rounded to two decimals.

per_person.instructions: Total due per customer in US dollars, rounded to two decimals.

expense_note.instructions: One short sentence for an expense report describing this meal.
